svg.aria-label: Bel–Robinson complexity near the bang for exact even scalar and tensor modes
svg.text: Figure 2. The bang as a complexity minimum
Positive Bel–Robinson complexity P. Solid: CPT-regular; dashed: irregular, no CPT.
Regular CPT modes: P ∝ η². Irregular no-CPT modes: P ∝ |η|⁻¹.
P/Pmax is exactly even and tends to zero at the bang.
Regular modes vanish from both sides. Panel (a) scales the tensor by ×¼; panel (b) normalises to its scalar maximum.
Linear order only: the metric is degenerate at η = 0, so P(0) = 0 is a two-sided limit, not a value at the bang.
